message:
fix(standby): a Release that finished wins over a late answer; a pending handoff stops the next pump read (keepalive-r2 2 r3, N2-a N2-b)

Codex codex_keepalive_r2_src_r3.md.

N2-a (reproduced there): what the handshake receives is fed in only while its operation is still the lease's -- same op,
still handed off, not cancelled, not stopped -- checked under the lock Release sets its cancel under; the success is
decided under that lock too. A packet that comes back from a wait a Release finished during is dropped: no true, no
features. The handshake ends as soon as its operation is no longer valid.

N2-b: ActivationArgs / ObserveFrom register their intent under the lock; the pump starts no new read while one is
pending, so they wait for the read in flight only. ObserveFrom now observes outside the lock (the socket is its alone
meanwhile: no pump read, no handoff). The header says exactly which waits are outside the lock: the CapabilityFn is
still called under it (the APK's is empty).

standby_lease_test 52/52 (x3, x5): both orders x6 rounds (Ack, Release, Pong / Pong, Release, Ack) never adopted; a
handoff and an observation registered during a read (test-only read hooks, REMOTE60_STANDBY_TEST_HOOKS) see no new read.
Mutants: no validity check in the steps+result, steps only, no intent priority, Release without cancel, stale start
-- all FAIL. e2e --product-client --real-directory --old-host 74/74, entry 72/72.
